title.en: Combat sprite sheet and transparent GIF
title.zh: 战斗精灵表与透明 GIF

summary.en: A widely shared workflow for turning character art into combat frames, followed by transparency repair and GIF assembly.
summary.zh: 把角色图转为战斗动作帧，再修复透明背景并组装 GIF 的高传播工作流。

model.evidence: The creator names GPT Image 2.5 in the source post; the repository has not independently verified the output model.

steps.en: Use the attached character as the reference. Draw a pixel-art combat sequence in a 4-by-4 sprite sheet. Keep the character scale and ground contact consistent between cells.
steps.zh: 以附件角色为参考，绘制 4×4 像素风战斗动作精灵表，保持每格中的角色大小与落脚点一致。

steps.en: In a fresh chat, remove the background from the sheet, separate its 16 cells, align the character in each frame, and assemble a looping GIF.
steps.zh: 在新对话中去除精灵表背景，拆分 16 格，逐帧对齐角色并组装循环 GIF。

inputs.en: A character reference; a file-processing tool for the GIF step.
inputs.zh: 角色参考图；GIF 步骤需要文件处理工具。

notes.en: This is an editorial recipe based on the published workflow, not a transcription of the original generation prompt.
notes.zh: 这是依据作者公开工作流整理的编辑配方，并非最初生图提示词的逐字抄录。

notes.en: The creator reported a failed transparency pass and used a fresh chat to repair it. A sprite sheet is not itself an animated GIF.
notes.zh: 作者报告首次透明化失败，随后用新对话修复。精灵表本身不是动态 GIF。

summary.en: Extract a visual style from a reference, then use it to stage a person holding a product.
summary.zh: 先从参考图提取视觉风格，再生成手持产品的人像。

model.evidence: The creator names GPT Image 2.5 in the source post; the repository has not independently verified the output model.

steps.en: Describe the reference photo as a reusable JSON style recipe: lighting, camera angle, palette, background, and photographic texture. Keep product and person identity out of the style fields.
steps.zh: 把参考照片概括为可复用的 JSON 风格配方：光线、机位、配色、背景和摄影质感。风格字段不包含产品或人物身份。

steps.en: Using the style recipe and attached product photo, create a natural photograph of a person holding the product. Preserve the product shape and visible label.
steps.zh: 使用风格配方和附件产品照片，生成一个人自然手持该产品的照片，保留产品形状和可见标签。

inputs.en: A style reference and a product photo; a text model for extracting the style recipe.
inputs.zh: 风格参考图与产品图；提取风格配方需要文本模型。

notes.en: Editorial adaptation of the creator’s two-stage recipe. The source first analyzes the reference with GPT-6 Astra, then generates the image.
notes.zh: 依据作者两阶段流程改写。原帖先使用 GPT-6 Astra 分析参考图，再生成图片。

notes.en: Save the first approved character image as a reference for later variations. The source post displays a paid-partnership label.
notes.zh: 将第一张满意的角色图保留为后续变体的参考图。原帖展示了付费合作标签。

title.en: A robot through nine sequential edits

summary.en: Repeat a small action cycle while feeding each result into the next edit.
summary.zh: 重复一个小动作循环，并将每次结果作为下一轮编辑的输入。

model.evidence: The creator names GPT Image 2.5 in the source post; the repository has not independently verified the output model.

steps.en: Make the robot pick up the star.
steps.zh: 让机器人捡起星星。

steps.en: Make the robot raise the star.
steps.zh: 让机器人举起星星。

steps.en: Make the robot return the star to its starting position.
steps.zh: 让机器人把星星放回原位。

inputs.en: An initial robot-and-star image. Use each output as the next input; repeat the three-step cycle three times.
inputs.zh: 一张机器人与星星的初始图。每轮输出作为下一轮输入，将三步循环重复三次。

notes.en: English editorial rendering of the Japanese action sequence. Inspect identity, texture, and background after every step.
notes.zh: 这是日文动作序列的英文编辑整理版。每一步都要检查角色身份、材质和背景。

notes.en: The original video is a side-by-side model comparison, not an independent repository test.
notes.zh: 原帖视频是模型对比，并非本仓库独立测试。

summary.en: Turn an uploaded character into a small pixel sprite with a consistent idle cycle.
summary.zh: 把上传角色转成小型像素精灵，制作一致的待机循环。

model.evidence: The creator names GPT Image 2.5 in the source post; the repository has not independently verified the output model.

steps.en: Using the character reference, draw 16 pixel-art idle frames in a 4-by-4 sheet on a 1024-by-1024 transparent canvas. Keep each character inside its 256-by-256 cell with a fixed baseline and generous padding. Use subtle breathing and one blink; preserve the character design.
steps.zh: 以参考角色绘制 16 帧像素风待机动画，按 4×4 排列在 1024×1024 透明画布上。每格 256×256，固定基线并留足边距。使用轻微呼吸和一次眨眼，保持角色设计。

steps.en: Split the sheet into individual PNG frames, align them, and export a transparent looping GIF plus the frames. Use nearest-neighbor resizing and inspect for clipping, position jumps, and false checkerboard transparency.
steps.zh: 拆分为单帧 PNG 并对齐，导出透明循环 GIF 及各帧。缩放使用最近邻采样，检查裁切、位置跳动以及画出来的假透明棋盘格。

inputs.en: A character reference and tools that can split images and write GIF/PNG files.
inputs.zh: 角色参考图，以及能够拆图和写入 GIF/PNG 的工具。

notes.en: Condensed adaptation of the long prompt in the author reply. It consistently requests an idle loop; the source also contains a dancing instruction.
notes.zh: 这是作者回复中长提示词的精简改写。这里统一为待机循环；原文还包含一处跳舞指令。

notes.en: The preview is a still from the creator’s post. File export requires a separate processing step.
notes.zh: 预览是作者帖中的静态图；文件导出需要独立处理步骤。

title.zh: 通过独立差分帧制作动画

summary.en: Use separate edited frames when a sprite grid distorts the character too much.
summary.zh: 精灵表导致角色变形时，改用独立编辑的差分帧。

model.evidence: The creator names GPT Image 2.5 in the source post; the repository has not independently verified the output model.

steps.en: Create nine separate variations of the supplied character image for a gentle animation. Change the pose only slightly between frames. Keep the character’s size, position, identity, and background consistent.
steps.zh: 基于提供的角色图，创建九张独立差分图用于轻柔动画。每帧只轻微改变姿势，保持角色大小、位置、身份和背景一致。

steps.en: Inspect and align the frames, then assemble them into a looping GIF. If the motion needs more in-between frames, create another set using the same references.
steps.zh: 检查并对齐各帧，再组装循环 GIF。若需要更多中间帧，使用相同参考再生成一组。

inputs.en: A character image; image editing and GIF assembly tools.
inputs.zh: 角色图；图像编辑与 GIF 组装工具。

notes.en: Editorial workflow adaptation. The creator reports using two sets of nine separate variations after a 3-by-3 sheet changed the design too much.
notes.zh: 这是工作流编辑改写。作者报告 3×3 精灵表导致设计变化过大，随后改为两组各九张独立差分图。

notes.en: The original base image was made with Nano Banana Pro; GPT Image 2.5 was used for subsequent edits.
notes.zh: 原始底图由 Nano Banana Pro 制作，后续编辑使用 GPT Image 2.5。

model.evidence: The creator names GPT Image 2.5 in the source post; the repository has not independently verified the output model.

steps.en: Create a vertical 9:16 travel-magazine page about [DESTINATION]. Blend the attached person naturally into the destination photography. Include a clear headline, short travel tips, recommendations, and photo captions. Use the whole page with a readable editorial hierarchy. Check every visible word.
steps.zh: 制作一张介绍 [目的地] 的 9:16 竖版旅行杂志页。把附件人物自然融入目的地照片，加入清晰标题、简短旅行提示、推荐和图片说明。充分利用版面，保证编辑层级清晰，并检查所有可见文字。

inputs.en: A person reference and a destination. Replace the bracketed placeholder.
inputs.zh: 人物参考图与目的地；替换方括号占位符。

notes.en: This condensed adaptation adds an explicit text-review step. The complete creator prompt is in the linked author reply.
notes.zh: 这是压缩改写版本，并明确增加了文字检查步骤。作者完整提示词见回复链接。

notes.en: Generated travel details need factual checking before publication.
notes.zh: 生成的旅行信息需在发布前核实。

summary.en: Generate an action sheet, then turn its frames into a looping animation.
summary.zh: 生成动作精灵表，再将各帧组合为循环动画。

model.evidence: The creator names GPT Image 2.5 in the source post; the repository has not independently verified the output model.

steps.en: Draw a pixel-art male goblin performing one bow-and-arrow action across 16 consecutive frames. Arrange the sequence as a sprite sheet with consistent scale and alignment.
steps.zh: 用像素风绘制男性哥布林拉弓射箭的一组连续动作，共 16 帧。排列为精灵表，保持角色大小和对齐一致。

steps.en: Separate the sprite sheet into frames and assemble a looping GIF. Inspect the loop for position jumps and frame-order mistakes.
steps.zh: 把精灵表拆分为单帧并组装循环 GIF，检查循环中的位置跳动与帧顺序错误。

inputs.en: An image-generation tool and a file-processing tool.
inputs.zh: 图像生成工具与文件处理工具。

notes.en: The source compares GPT Image 2.5 with an older model. Open the post and use the first demonstration for the 2.5 example.
notes.zh: 原帖对比了 GPT Image 2.5 与旧模型；2.5 对应第一段演示。

notes.en: The recipe is adapted; frame alignment and smooth motion are not guaranteed.
notes.zh: 这是改写配方，不能保证逐帧对齐或运动流畅。

title.en: Redesign a poster while retaining its world
title.zh: 保留世界观的海报重设计

summary.en: Change the perspective and copy while preserving a poster’s overall visual structure.
summary.zh: 改变视角和文案，同时保留海报整体视觉结构。

model.evidence: The creator names GPT Image 2.5 in the source post; the repository has not independently verified the output model.

steps.en: Using the original poster as reference, retain its overall composition and visual world. Reinterpret it from a male perspective and replace all visible text with new copy that fits the revised concept.
steps.zh: 以原海报为参考，保留整体构图和视觉世界观，从男性视角重新演绎，并将所有可见文字替换为符合新概念的文案。

inputs.en: The original poster. For production work, provide the exact replacement copy.
inputs.zh: 原始海报；用于正式成品时请提供需要替换的准确文案。

notes.en: English adaptation of the Japanese instruction. The original post labels the new result on the left and the earlier-model original on the right.
notes.zh: 依据日文指令改写。原帖说明左侧为新结果，右侧为旧模型原图。
